en.summary: The repository exhibits high overall popularity with nearly 3,900 stars and a manageable issue count. However, a lapse in activity with no commits for over four months suggests maintenance may have slowed down.
signals: High star count (3,901) and moderate forks (205) demonstrate strong initial adoption.
Low open issue count (11) indicates a manageable backlog.
No code updates for 135 days points to recent inactivity.
Recent open issues focus on minor enhancements and path/link updates.
